subject: Aligning demo to exec travel & CTO availability
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@horizonai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo — executive alignment and timing

Hi Marcus / Priyom,

Thanks again for the fast turnaround on the discovery notes. We'd like to schedule a demo the week of Sept 21 — our CTO (Liam) asked to join if possible, but he is traveling the week of the 21st and will only be back in the office on Sept 29. We can do an internal review with product folks earlier in the week, but we want Liam to see the exec-level summary and the key latency/cost controls before we move forward.

Two asks:
- Can you provide a short 20–25 minute exec overview tailored to CTO concerns (latency SLOs, dedicated capacity options, and rollouts)?
- If we can't get Liam on the earlier slots, can we shift the full demo to the 29th?

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Sept 22 10:00–11:00
- Sept 23 14:00–15:00
- Sept 29 09:30–11:00 (Liam available)

Also, our VP of Platform, Maya Rivera, may want to sit in for part of the session — she'll likely ask to join the exec overview only. If we need to split into two back-to-back sessions (exec + tech deep dive), that's fine.

Thanks,
Samantha
Director, Partnerships
Horizon AI
[Attachment: horizon-requirements.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@horizonai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — executive alignment and timing

Hi Samantha — great context, thanks.

We can absolutely accommodate both an exec overview and a technical deep dive. Two quick thoughts:
1) If Liam is only available on the 29th, we can schedule a 25-minute exec overview (for Liam + Maya) at 09:30 PDT on the 29th and then follow immediately with a 60-minute technical session for your product/infra team.
2) Alternatively, if you want an internal dry run earlier that the product folks attend, we can keep Sept 22 or 23 for the technical deep dive and then record it for Liam — but I agree it's better to have him live for the exec summary.

I've looped in Priyom (SE) to prep an exec brief that highlights latency SLOs, caching/batching controls, and Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs. Priyom — can you put together a 12–15 slide exec brief and a short 2-slide appendix on recommended rollout strategies? I can draft the invite once we lock time.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed-demo-outline.txt]

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@horizonai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Harper <liam.harper@horizonai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — executive alignment and timing

Thanks Marcus — looping Liam so he can confirm availability.

Liam: I'm on travel through the 28th and will be available the morning of the 29th (09:30–11:30 PDT works). Maya would like to join the first 20 minutes for the high-level view only.

If possible, we'd like the exec overview at 09:30–09:55 and then the tech session at 10:00–11:00. If you prefer a single contiguous meeting, we can do 09:30–11:00 with a 20-minute exec intro at the top.

Also — one constraint: our security team asked for a short write-up on data retention and audit logs up front. Could you include a slide or appendix covering retention, audit log exports, and SOC 2 scope?

Appreciate it,
Samantha

On Tue, Sep 14, 2026 at 11:02 AM Liam Harper <liam.harper@horizonai.com> wrote:
> Marcus / Samantha — 09/29 morning should work for me. Please keep the exec portion succinct.
> 
> Liam Harper
> CTO, Horizon AI

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@horizonai.com>, Liam Harper <liam.harper@horizonai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Confirming 09/29 — exec overview + tech deep dive (calendar attached)

Thanks for confirming, team. Locking in the proposal below:

Option A (preferred):
- 09/29/2026 09:30–09:55 PDT — 25-minute exec overview (Marcus + Priyom) — audience: Liam (CTO), Maya (VP Platform), Samantha
- 09:55–10:05 — 10-minute break / buffer
- 10:05–11:05 — 60-minute technical deep dive (Priyom + SE team) — audience: Horizon product/infra

Option B (single contiguous meeting):
- 09/29/2026 09:30–11:00 PDT — combined session with a 20-minute exec intro at the top.

Per Samantha's note, there's a small security cue — Priyom will include a 2-slide appendix that covers data retention, audit logs, and SOC 2 scope. We'll also attach the short exec brief and the main demo deck for your review.

Attaching: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (full deck), exec-overview-15min.pdf (tailored), calendar-invite.ics

Marissa (CS lead) — I'm copying you to make sure we surface any billing/SLA questions in advance; can you confirm who on your side should receive the post-demo follow-up and the mutual action plan?

Please reply with preferred option (A/B) and whether you want us to split into two meetings or keep one contiguous invite. If A, I'll send two calendar events (exec invite + tech invite) with matching join links.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (PDF, 6MB)]
[Attachment: exec-overview-15min.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]
[Attachment: calendar-invite.ics (iCal)]

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@horizonai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Confirming 09/29 — exec overview + tech deep dive (calendar attached)

Hi Marcus — Option A works best for us. Please send two invites so Maven (our calendar system) splits the exec and tech sessions.

A couple quick asks ahead of the exec session:
- Please include a slide that lists the exact Dedicated SKU options and the expected cold-start latency ranges for each.
- The security slide should mention retention defaults and the process for audit log exports (S3/HUMAN-friendly export).

We'll confirm attendee list (exact names) by Monday; for now: Liam Harper (CTO), Maya Rivera (VP Platform), Samantha Ortiz (Director Partnerships), and 2x product leads.

Thanks for accommodating the shift — appreciate the clear buffer in the schedule. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Samantha
Director, Partnerships
Horizon AI
[Attachment: horizon-attendees-draft.csv]
